name: 358-dance-ring
notes: #358 B2.e ring dance (weddings, the festival): seven dancers on a ring of r = 0.3 + 0.03 x max(0, n - 6) (the kit's RingGroup, in step on purpose: exempt from P6), arms out so the hands meet, the ring turns 25 deg/s and reverses every 4 beats, a hop on each 0.5 s beat; every 8 beats all step in to 0.6 r with arms up and a cheer bounce, and out. After 24 beats the ring stops and everyone cheers (the end beat). AnimLab: cheat 'Dance ring now'.
